RL Datix Holdings (USA), Inc. - First lien senior secured GBP term loan; GBP par 30,607; amortized cost 41,306; fair value 39,656

findings.detail: Non-USD debt par is retained in source currency but the required USD principal field is missing on the flagged rows.

rationale: Class 1 repeated-cell review. The raw March 31, 2026 investment schedule explicitly identifies debt as EUR or GBP and prints local-currency par, while adjacent amortized cost and fair value are USD amounts. The 19 flagged records have blank principal_amount_usd, so the platform lacks the explicit FX-normalized principal required for USD par analytics. Source coordinates directly ground the defect; no aggregate anchor is needed.
